policies.reason: All current pure owner and link modules use the same existing serde, serde_json and sha2 requirements. Root inheritance prevents silent version or feature drift without forcing an unused dependency into a future module.

All nine accepted owner privacy-scope adapters use the existing prost 0.14 and sha2 0.10 requirements, while the only serde and serde_json consumer uses the existing root requirements. Root inheritance prevents contract, serialization or hashing drift without changing SQLx, Tokio or runtime behavior.
